verification.verification: git apply --check + apply + normalized UTF-8 content
verification.line_endings: git apply may normalize CRLF/LF; exact current bytes are in atlas_sprint13_modified.zip

known_limitations: Fuzzy addressing operates on STT/text output; acoustic wake quality remains dependent on the existing local STT/wake source.
The recent-address window is 90 seconds; outside it a voice utterance needs an address or a new wake event.
Self-knowledge reports only registries and providers instantiated in the current runtime.
A process restart reconstructs safe mission/context state and replans; it does not serialize an executing Python call stack.
The suite retains two upstream websockets deprecation warnings.
